::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 7th 1863  
**From:** Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add 54920: : 1-2:
:::

[Sir](people/person_939.qmd),

[Mr Furnival](people/person_531.qmd) has forwarded to me your proposal of dealing with me for my tale of the [Clever Woman of the Family](cmy_books/cmybook_58.qmd) as a book - I should be obliged if you would let me know your terms for publishing on commission; and like wise if in case of such an arrangement being practicable, whether you would take charge of my works that have been hitherto in [Mr Parker](people/person_1144.qmd)’s hands - All have been published by commission, excepting the two first, the [Heir of Redclyffe](cmy_books/cmybook_15.qmd) and [Heartsease](cmy_books/cmybook_19.qmd) which were on the half profit system, and respecting which it would be necessary to make an arrangement with Mr Parker -

The last years half profits on the Heir of Redclyffe were £28 .. 15 - on Heartsease £9..13 -

I mention this to facilitate your estimate of the worth of the half profits in case you should wish to purchase them

Your obt servt 

C. M. Yonge

---

**Note:** Black-edged paper. Serialised in *Churchman's Family Magazine*, Jan 1864 to March 1865 and published by Macmillan and Co. 1865.
